newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan September jobless rate at 3.03 percent.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan September jobless rate at 3.03 percent.

text.p: Taiwan's unemployment rate was at 3.03 percent in September, down from a 10-year high 3.19 percent hit in August, the Directorate General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics said on Wednesday.
The number of unemployed people in September decreased 13,000 to 284,000 from August, while the number of employed increased 71,000 to 9.067 million.
The bureau attributed the slight decline in joblessness to new graduates' gradual absorption by the labour market.
The average unemployment period was 21 weeks, it said.
Unemployment among college graduates was at 3.93 percent in September, down from 4.19 percent in August.
The directorate gave no forecast for October unemployment.
